context: User-provided 2026-11-02 X thread; evaluate an alternative swarm model index and 8 featured or thread-sampled Hugging Face model IDs for lawful reproducible local preservation.

post.claim: Pirate Face added 1000 model torrents, with examples. Claim originates from service, not an independent audit.

publisher_claims: Community Torrent listings reference a Hugging Face repository and pinned revision and can include only a subset of files.
Matching Hugging Face SHA-256 when available is the proposed source integrity mechanism.
Pirate Face itself describes itself as an index, not the weight host; P2P depends on actual complete peers after webseeds disappear.
Site listing policy says redistribution licenses restrict eligibility and some special licenses require accepting terms; Gated or non-commercial rights are not bypassed.
BitTorrent connectivity discloses peers' IP addresses; it does not provide anonymity.
independent_limitations: No torrent magnet fetched, no peer connectivity checked, no source-vs-torrent file manifest equality verified.
A listed magnet does not show that a complete copy is presently seeded.
A torrent-piece recheck or site's advertised hash matching is not evidence that a model is safe or correctly licensed.
The open HF license metadata of the sample does not prove all derivatives or underlying data are redistributable.
No third-party package, shell installer, HF_ENDPOINT override or network interception adopted.

compact_candidates.why: CVPR 2025 EoMT: prompt-independent panoptic/semantic/instance segmentation, unlike the interactive SAM2 tiny mask baseline; small model offers another precise spatial capability.
compact_candidates.limitations: MIT as published on Hub and official GitHub. No proven urgent withdrawal or regulation. Verify config, task metrics, runtime; selected safetensors is not proven bit-identical to excluded PyTorch bin.

compact_candidates.why: ResNet18 fine-tuned on EuroSAT RGB satellite Sentinel-2 image chips for 10 land-cover classes. Tiny independent remote-sensing classifier for reproducible baseline, not equivalent to multispectral Prithvi-EO.
compact_candidates.limitations: MIT according to Hub and official code. Original satellite dataset rights not independently audited. Vendor card accuracy not independently reproduced; official model openly available and no loss risk evidenced.

vetting_stages: 1. Verify first-party repo and complete revision with HF; verify exact filename, LFS SHA256, upstream card and correct license and conditional obligations.
2. Check overlaps with the portfolio; only new distinctive abilities or rare original training justify capacity.
3. Determine complete needed original files, dependencies, correct backend and disk footprint, not the site's total torrent count.

4. Only if legal and access conditions permit, check whether a third-party torrent covers every selected path and hash, with complete seed availability and separately approved networking/privacy risks.
5. No autonomous torrent consumption, seeding, public-IP exposure, Gated license bypass, software installation or approved queue mutation.
caveats: The two R2 candidate models have small first-party weights, but no proven access withdrawal or government regulatory threat.
Their repo sizes include alternative .bin checkpoint weights; selected metadata uses Safetensors only and cannot claim proven tensor equivalence without testing.
No torrent listing verified for these specific two models. Their presence in the post thread does not establish a live seed.
All capacities in decimal bytes and selected files are not full offline runtime dependencies.
